capabilities: Show games as a grid of cards with colour, emoji or cover image
Mark a game played when opened and reset marks each day
Count per-game streaks and an overall streak in the header
Paste share text results onto cards and into the daily note
Filter by category or unplayed games and open the next one
disambiguation: Not a set of games to play inside Obsidian; it is a board that opens external daily games and tracks what you played.
extras: Results are written as plain text in a code block so pasted web content cannot become links, embeds or scripts; the plugin makes no network requests of its own and validates its data file on load. The board can also be placed in a note with a daily-games code block. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later.
problem: Daily games live on separate websites, so it is hard to see at a glance which ones you have already played today or how long your streaks are.

relations.evidence: With the Web viewer core plugin on, games open in an Obsidian tab.
This needs the Daily notes core plugin.

summary: Board of cards for the daily puzzle and trivia games you play, showing what is left today, streaks, and pasted results.
